jobs.description: 1 Supply Chain Team Lead (f/m/x) Job OverviewENPULSION is looking for a Supply Chain Team Lead (f/m/x) to join our team. In this role, you will lead and coordinate daily supply chain operations, including procurement, inventory management, warehousing, logistics, and production planning. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will coordinate the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and ensure efficient and reliable supply chain processes. As a hands-on leader, you will guide and develop your team, monitor key performance indicators, and actively support operational activities when needed. You will play a key role in optimizing supply chain performance and supporting ENPULSION's continued growth.Key Responsibilities: * Manage and coordinate the daily activities of the SCM team, including procurement, inventory management, warehousing, logistics and production planning. * Provide leadership, guidance, and mentorship to all team members.  * Conduct performance reviews, identify training needs, and foster a collaborative and high-performing team environment. * Coordinate the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process with all departments  * Manage obsolescence, including monitoring at-risk components and proposing mitigation measures. * Create and monitor SCM KPIs and report on performance to the Head of SCM * Identifying areas for improvement within the department * Actively participate in the design, testing, and implementation of new SCM processes * Support the team with operational tasks when needed- including during absence, holidays, demanding periods Type of contract: Full time, permanent position with 38.5 hours/ week. Salary: The minimum base salary for this position starts at € 3.415, 01 gross per month on a full-time basis (38.5 h/week), with a planned significant overpayment of € 4.000-4.500 depending on your professional experience and qualifications.Your profile * Proven practical experience in day-to-day supply chain operations within a manufacturing environment, including direct involvement in procurement, inventory management, logistics, and production planning. * Minimum 5 years of professional experience in supply chain management or operations within a manufacturing environment, including at least 2-3 years in a team lead or supervisory role. * Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, Logistics, Business Administration or a related field. * Experience as a key user or power user of an ERP system, particularly in SCM modules. * Strong understanding of manufacturing supply chain processes, including procurement, inventory control, warehousing, and logistics. * Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. * Demonstrated ability to analyse data, identify trends, and drive process improvements. * Excellent command of English, both written and spoken, and conversational proficiency in German.Why us?At ENPULSION, you'll join a young, international team united by a deep passion for space technology and innovation. We foster a friendly, open-minded work environment that encourages new ideas and rewards initiative. Our culture is fast-paced and growth-oriented - a place where your work will have a real impact, and where you can truly leave your mark.Our benefits include:  * 25 days of paid vacation * Choice between a KlimaTicket (Metropol region), a parking space or cantina vouchers for on-site dining * Role-dependent FlexTime and home office options * Monthly team lunches and regular team-building events * Learning & development budget to support your continued growth * Firmenradl - Bike Leasing program * Office located at VIE Airport City with access to: ** FitFabrik Fitness Center ** Airport Health Center ** Shops, restaurants, and Crew Shop discounts ** VIE Community App for news and dealsPlease submit your application via this link:https://www.enpulsion.com/careers/position/2840795/...
